'''2015 MPC Aaron Kingery LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Aaron Kingery]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth (location)|Hoth-L-hoth.gif|label=Hoth}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
